subject: FY 2026 Budget Public Engagement Plan
overview: The committee approved the April City Council newsletter and discussed a public engagement plan, including a resident survey, for the upcoming FY 2026 budget.

items.title: April City Council Newsletter
items.summary: The committee approved the draft of the April City Council newsletter after incorporating several editorial updates and updates on recent council ordinances.

items.title: Human Rights Commission Enabling Ordinance Modernization
items.summary: The committee received an update on discussions with the mayor regarding stipends and membership size for the Human Rights Commission, leaving the matter tabled pending further review.

items.title: FY 2026 Budget Public Engagement Plan
items.summary: The committee discussed designing a public survey and educational budget graphics, and approved a motion to request feedback from councilors ahead of an upcoming meeting to finalize the plan.
